text: Output is structured as a naming review with tiers such as Must Rename and Consider Renaming
Each finding is given as a current-to-proposed pair with a reason, not vague advice
Flags process as hiding the responsibility, and proposes a name stating the actual work (validating and posting line items to the ledger)
Flags _do_stuff and _check as placeholder names, proposing names for the real operations (posting to the ledger plus notifying, and validating amount and currency)
Flags the boolean flag parameter on handle as unnameable at the call site, and proposes splitting into two named methods or a named enum
Flags DataManager as a name whose vagueness signals a design problem, and connects the naming struggle to the class doing validation, persistence, and notification
Raises the multi-responsibility design concern explicitly, not only the surface renames
Flags the abbreviated ledger key amt as inconsistent with the amount attribute it stores
